name: tech-prediction-adr0274-validation-20261021
notes: ADR-0274 VALIDATION document on the next-session label: (A) vol-scaled label, (B) Kalman-OU spread state, (C) pooled and blended models fit across the fifteen-name cohort and scored on the three phase-one pairs. Scores 2021-2025 once with the knobs frozen in prediction-adr0274-selection.json; family per cell: models versus lagged (DM) and versus mean, BH 5%. No trade rule, P&L or edge claim.
